question: Which sport is played by the Indian sportsperson Vikas Krishan Yadav?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Boxing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vikas Krishan Yadav is an Indian sportsperson who competes in boxing. 
 
• Vikas has represented India in several international competitions, including the **Olympics.**
 
• He gained significant recognition after winning a bronze medal at the **2011 World Boxing Championships held in Baku, Azerbaijan**, and has also competed in the 2012 London Olympics and the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
 
• Vikas has also won multiple medals at the Asian Championships, further establishing his status as one of India's top boxers.
